question: How many repeat customers were there in January–June 2025 and in July–December 2025? Evaluate repeat status separately within each reporting period, then say which half had more.

action.query:
SELECT reporting_period, COUNT(DISTINCT CUSTOMER_ID) AS repeat_customer_count
FROM (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID,
           CASE WHEN ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2025-07-01' THEN 'H1_2025'
                WHEN ORDER_DATE >= '2025-07-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01' THEN 'H2_2025' END AS reporting_period
    FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER
    WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
      AND IS_CANCELLED = FALSE
    GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID, reporting_period
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ORDER_ID) > 1
) t
GROUP BY reporting_period
ORDER BY reporting_period;

action.answer: In January–June 2025 (H1_2025), there were 94,512 repeat customers (customers with more than one non-cancelled order in that period). In July–December 2025 (H2_2025), there were 96,095 repeat customers (evaluated independently for that half-year). H2_2025 had more repeat customers than H1_2025. Population: all customers with more than one non-cancelled order in each respective half of 2025. Unit: unique customers per half-year. Interpretation: Customer repeat activity was slightly higher in the second half of 2025.
